Thanks again for the time last week. Two things we need to lock before we publish the run-of-show:

2) Procurement gating: we need a sign-off path on the mutual action plan so Legal/Finance can fast-track the SOW.

Candidate windows (PT):
- Option A: Wed Dec 8, 09:00–09:40 PT (tight, exec-friendly)
- Option B: Thu Dec 9, 13:00–13:40 PT (preferred if your procurement owner needs time)

If neither works, propose two alternate 30–45 minute blocks and we’ll stitch the demo to fit. I’ve attached a compact agenda and a mutual action plan that maps deliverables to owners.

Ask: can your procurement inbox (procure@brightcare.com) confirm the expected redline turnaround? If Legal needs a full SOW in advance I can forward our SOW template; otherwise, a redline window of 48 hours post-demo would let us hit the renewal date.

Attachments: Proposed-QBR-Agenda.pdf, Mutual-Action-Plan.xlsx

Links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4392), DocuSign prep: https://docusign.com/embedded/abc123
